udce473ebb4: Sometimes the following error appears when you open Code::Blocks. This is because Code::Blocks looks for gcc on the system and reports an error when it cannot find it. However, since we do not use gcc, ⟦1⟧this has no effect⟦/1⟧. If you do not want the error to appear again, you can install GNU GCC, for example by installing the codeblocks-mingw32 version.
uf89a5cf12e: This happens because the compiler specified in the cbp project cannot be found in the global configuration of the Code::Blocks installed on this computer. There are two possibilities:
u71e8631f0c: The compiler specified by the current cbp project is wrong (to check it, see ⟦1⟧How to Check Which Toolset the Current Project Uses⟦/1⟧)
ub310784e1f: The compiler specified by the current cbp project is correct, but the global configuration of Code::Blocks on this computer has not been updated (that is, the toolchain needs to be updated)
ucec1baad12: If the toolchain is already the latest version, the existing configuration on the computer may have been corrupted for some reason.
udbdb49b403: In general, first reinstall the latest version of the ⟦1⟧toolchain (click here to download)⟦/1⟧, then check whether the problem still occurs.
